definitions.name: bridge_refresh_sessions
definitions.sql:
CREATE TABLE `bridge_refresh_sessions` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int NOT NULL,
  `token_hash` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `expires_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `revoked_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_used_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `user_agent` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_ip` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `credential_version` tinyint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '3',
  `installation_id` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `profile_id` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `generation` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `migration_key` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `source_fingerprint` char(71) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `source_refresh_session_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_bridge_refresh_token` (`token_hash`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_bridge_refresh_migration_key` (`migration_key`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_bridge_refresh_source_migration` (`source_refresh_session_id`),
  KEY `idx_bridge_refresh_user` (`user_id`,`revoked_at`,`expires_at`),
  KEY `idx_bridge_refresh_expiry` (`expires_at`),
  KEY `idx_bridge_refresh_device` (`user_id`,`installation_id`,`profile_id`,`credential_version`,`revoked_at`,`expires_at`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=24 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

definitions.name: users
definitions.sql:
CREATE TABLE `users` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `uid` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `email` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `email_verified` tinyint DEFAULT NULL,
  `auth_method` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `password` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `nickname` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `avatar` varchar(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `role` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user',
  `plan` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'free',
  `plan_period` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `plan_expires_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `telegram_id` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `telegram_username` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `telegram_name` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `telegram_chat_id` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `telegram_group_status` varchar(50) DEFAULT '',
  `telegram_bot_started_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `telegram_joined_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `telegram_last_invite_sent_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `referral_code` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `referral_credit` decimal(20,8) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00000000',
  `referred_by` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_seen_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `bridge_heartbeat` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT (now(3)),
  `updated_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT (now(3)),
  `phone` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `phone_verified` tinyint DEFAULT NULL,
  `changelog_seen_version` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `token_version` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `plan_source` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `deleted_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `deletion_status` varchar(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
  `last_seen_at_utc` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `profile_revision` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `email` (`email`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uid` (`uid`),
  UNIQUE KEY `referral_code` (`referral_code`),
  UNIQUE KEY `idx_users_phone` (`phone`),
  KEY `idx_users_last_seen` (`last_seen_at`),
  KEY `idx_users_deletion_status` (`deletion_status`,`deleted_at`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=31 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

definitions.name: ai_model_profiles
definitions.sql:
CREATE TABLE `ai_model_profiles` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `owner_user_id` int NOT NULL,
  `scope` enum('user','platform') NOT NULL,
  `provider` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `model_name` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `api_base_url` varchar(512) DEFAULT NULL,
  `api_key_encrypted` text,
  `key_version` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `temperature` decimal(3,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `max_tokens` int unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `thinking_enabled` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `reasoning_effort` varchar(16) DEFAULT NULL,
  `request_timeout_ms` int unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `is_default` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `status` varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'inactive',
  `created_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `deleted_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `active_default_owner_key` int GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((case when ((`is_default` = 1) and (`status` = _utf8mb4'active') and (`deleted_at` is null)) then `owner_user_id` else NULL end)) STORED /*!80023 INVISIBLE */,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_model_active_default_owner` (`active_default_owner_key`),
  KEY `idx_model_profiles_owner` (`owner_user_id`,`deleted_at`),
  KEY `idx_model_profiles_scope` (`scope`,`status`,`deleted_at`),
  KEY `idx_v4_model_profiles_owner` (`owner_user_id`,`scope`,`status`,`deleted_at`,`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_v4_model_profiles_owner` CHECK ((((`scope` = _utf8mb4'platform') and (`owner_user_id` = 0)) or ((`scope` = _utf8mb4'user') and (`owner_user_id` > 0))))
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=7 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

definitions.name: ai_model_provider_capabilities
definitions.sql:
CREATE TABLE `ai_model_provider_capabilities` (
  `model_profile_id` int NOT NULL,
  `provider` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `model_name` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `api_base_url` varchar(512) DEFAULT NULL,
  `protocol` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `supports_stream` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `supports_request_id` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `supports_poll` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `supports_cancel` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `supports_idempotency` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `supports_structured_output` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `supports_usage_split` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `context_window_tokens` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `max_input_tokens` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `max_output_tokens` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `context_limit_semantics` varchar(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'shared_context',
  `token_limits_source` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'generic_default',
  `token_limits_status` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'default_unconfirmed',
  `token_limits_note` varchar(512) DEFAULT NULL,
  `token_limits_updated_by` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `token_limits_updated_at_utc_msc` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `verification_status` varchar(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unverified',
  `verified_by_user_id` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `verified_at_utc_msc` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at_utc_msc` bigint NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`model_profile_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

definitions.name: ai_model_usage_logs
definitions.sql:
CREATE TABLE `ai_model_usage_logs` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int NOT NULL,
  `model_profile_id` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `credential_source` varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  `usage` varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  `request_phase` varchar(16) NOT NULL,
  `strategy_id` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `token_count` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `request_status` varchar(16) NOT NULL,
  `error_code` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `request_bytes` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `response_bytes` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `duration_ms` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `input_tokens` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `output_tokens` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `reasoning_tokens` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `cached_tokens` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `provider_request_id` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `finish_reason` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `incomplete_details_json` text,
  `accounting_status` varchar(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'usage_unknown',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_usage_logs_user` (`user_id`,`created_at`),
  KEY `idx_usage_logs_usage` (`usage`,`created_at`),
  KEY `idx_usage_provider_request` (`provider_request_id`),
  KEY `idx_v4_model_usage_quota` (`user_id`,`credential_source`,`created_at`,`request_phase`),
  KEY `idx_v4_model_usage_recovery` (`request_status`,`created_at`,`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=12140 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
